<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template for the Doebner modification (aldehyde + malonic acid → α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid). I will search the template catalog for reactions that form a C=C double bond while breaking a C‑C single bond and a C‑O single bond. Then I will apply the found template to the product (cinnamic acid, SMILES “O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1”) to obtain all possible precursor sets.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1",
    "functional_groups_broken": null,
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C=C"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C=C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
